findings.problem: The preview (line 2) promises 'a look at some of our favourite new arrivals', and line 10 says 'A few pieces have quickly become our own favourites, and we thought you would like to see them.' But the only link goes to the general new-arrivals page (line 14). This breaks the link rule in .claude/rules/emails.md: don't promise a special 'our favourites' page when the link opens the general new-arrivals page.
findings.fix: Stop promising a favourites view. Change the preview to something like 'A personal thank-you, and a look at our new winter arrivals.' Change line 10 to 'This winter, we have carefully chosen new fabric that we are proud of, and we thought you would like to see it.' Or, if a real favourites page exists, point the link to it with matching button text.
